name: DNSControl Open-Source DNS-as-Code
free_limit: MIT-licensed free cross-platform DNS-as-code CLI for managing DNS records through provider APIs, with preview/push commands and support for multiple DNS providers; no software seat or zone quotas.
watch_out: Local CLI is not a free DNS hosting provider; DNS registrar/hosting/API charges, provider limits, domain registrations and automation infrastructure remain your responsibility. Protect provider API credentials.
